issues: Focus Mode 弹窗内容溢出：绝对定位的 Confirm 压住 Pro 选项，Pro 正文从按钮下方漏出弹窗底边
描边收敛时颜色在 settle=0.5 一帧硬切 #fff0c4→#e6c887，可见跳色
字体走 system-ui 回退，金字与弹窗标题无字距/字重层级
弹窗、按钮、仪表盘外框只有平涂 + 实色边，没有受光上沿，黑金质感偏塑料
大面积近黑暖色渐变无颗粒，暗部有色带
changes: 弹窗改为纵向 flex，Confirm 用 margin-top:auto 贴底；文案压短到能在 117×108 设计 px 内完整排下，单选圈改为真的 radio 图形
描边颜色随 settle 逐帧 RGB 插值，笔宽/辉光收敛与颜色同步
换系统字栈：金字 500 字重 −0.025em、弹窗标题 650 字重，开启字距调整
弹窗、选项框、Confirm、仪表盘外框补顶部内高光 + 0.5 设计 px 发丝线 + 接触阴影；选中项加金色微渐变底
整幅叠暖黑暗角（0.5）+ soft-light 颗粒（0.10）；时间轴、姿态关键帧、光斑路径与描边起笔点全部保持原值
issuesEn: The Focus Mode modal overflowed: the absolutely positioned Confirm button covered the Pro option, whose copy leaked out below the modal edge
During the stroke settle the colour hard-switched #fff0c4→#e6c887 in a single frame at settle=0.5, a visible pop
Fonts fell back to system-ui; the gold title and modal heading had no tracking or weight hierarchy
Modal, buttons and dashboard frame were flat fills with solid borders and no lit top edge, so the black-and-gold read as plastic
The large near-black warm gradients had no grain and banded in the shadows
changesEn: Modal rebuilt as a vertical flex column with Confirm pinned via margin-top:auto; copy tightened to fit the 117×108 design-px box, radio markers are now real radio glyphs
Stroke colour interpolates in RGB with settle, in step with the stroke-width and glow decay
System font stack: the gold word at 500 weight and −0.025em, modal heading at 650, kerning on
Modal, option boxes, Confirm and dashboard frame gained a top inner highlight, 0.5 design-px hairline and contact shadow; the selected option got a faint gold gradient
Warm-black vignette (0.5) and soft-light grain (0.10) over the frame; timeline, pose keyframes, light path and stroke start point are unchanged
